text:
Hi everyone, I’m posting on behalf of my mom because we urgently need help with an ETA-IL issue. 🙏

In July, my parents and younger brother travelled to Israel to visit me. They had approved ETA-IL authorizations, but unfortunately, they were denied entry upon arrival and sent back to Romania.

Now, I’ve obtained approval from the Israeli Ministry of Interior for tourist visas for both my parents, and the required deposits have been paid. However, we’re facing problems with their ETA-IL authorizations.

My mom tried to retrieve her original authorization by email. First, she received a denial notification, but after trying again, she received confirmation of approval. This morning, she submitted a new application, which was denied. Meanwhile, my dad no longer has access to the email address used for his original application, so we cannot retrieve his authorization or verify its status.

Their flight is on October 24 — in just two days! We already have approval from the Ministry of Interior, and we urgently need clarification about the ETA-IL requirements.

We’ve contacted the relevant support channels, but they didn’t answer yet and we’re running out of time.

Has anyone experienced a similar situation or knows who we can contact to resolve this urgently? Any advice or help would mean so much to our family. ❤️

Thank you!
